answer: Pay rewards per independent economic life, not per head. Each epoch the ledger clusters identities whose earnings end up at the same destinations, and each cluster shares a single reward, like a thousand bees carrying nectar to one hive that only counts as one forager. Splitting into many copper-thin accounts gains nothing, and even a whisper of shared payouts later merges them back. Honest agents with their own counterparties are unaffected.
